desc: Type a name and get a savage roast card with a Roast Level score. Send it to your group chat.

items.text: You spend 12 hours on your phone and still say you're busy.

items.title: The Silent Listener
items.text: You read every message in the group and never reply. Are you Agent 007?

items.title: The Midnight Chef
items.text: Your 2 AM Maggi skills are unmatched. Chef Gordon is shaking.

items.title: The Future Billionaire
items.text: Your plans are legendary. Execution starts after 11 AM on Sunday.

title: What's Your Meme Personality?
desc: Answer 3 quick questions and find out which meme you really are.

questions.q: Your friends are planning a trip. You...

options.text: Book everything and make a group itinerary
Say 'I'm in!' and then sleep through the alarm
Bring snacks and watch everyone argue
A 'like' on a post you forgot you made
Your bank account showing a surprise credit
A silent group chat that ends with 'lol'

boss.title: The Main Character 👑
boss.text: You plan, you lead, you're the reason the group works. Everyone else is just following.

chaos.title: The Chaos Gremlin 💥
chaos.text: You make the plans, break the plans, and somehow it still ends up as a legendary story.

observer.title: The Silent Observer 👀
observer.text: You see everything, say nothing, and drop the one line that wins the whole group chat.

title: Would You Rather
desc: Pick a side, share it, and see if your friends agree.

items.a: Have a day off every week

title: Truth or Dare 😈
desc: Pick Truth or Dare. Every round is a new question or task, with thousands of combinations, so no repeats.
truths: What's the most embarrassing song you secretly love?
What's the last thing you searched at 2 AM?
Who in your group would survive longest in a zombie movie, and why is it you?
What fake skill have you pretended to have?
What's your most unhinged opinion about pizza?
Which emoji do you use way too much?
What's a lie you told to get out of plans?
What's the cringiest thing in your phone's notes app?
If your life had a soundtrack, what would play when you walk into a room?
What food do you pretend to like?
Have you ever waved back at someone who wasn't waving at you?
What's your go-to excuse when you're late?
What's the most dramatic thing you've done over a coffee order?
What's something you were 100% sure about that was totally wrong?
What app do you open first every morning?
Which pet would you swap lives with for one day, and why?
What's the most useless talent you have?
Which contact do you pretend you don't know in a group chat?
What would your superhero name be, and what's its weakness?
What rule do you break every single day?
What's a word you mispronounced for years before anyone told you?
If you had a theme song for your Monday mornings, what would it be?
dares: Send your last selfie to the group chat, with no filter and no caption.
Talk only in movie trailer voice for your next 3 messages.
Do your best dance move for 10 seconds and send it as a video.
Send a 'Good morning' voice note to the group, right now.
Let the group write your next status for 1 hour.
Do 10 push-ups while reciting your favorite dialogue.
Compliment the last person you chatted with, in Shakespearean English.
Use only emojis for your next 3 messages.
Set a random song as your status and say 'this is my anthem.'
Walk backward for 20 steps, then take a photo of it.
Rap your current mood in 4 lines.
Sing the chorus of your favorite song, as loud as you can, right now.
dareTemplates: Talk in a {accent} accent for the next {minutes} minutes.
Narrate your day like a {animal} on a nature documentary.
Do a {animal} impression for 15 seconds. Let the group guess the animal.
Give a 30-second motivational speech to your {object}.
Rate your {thing} out of 10, out loud, and defend your score like a judge.
For the next 5 minutes, answer everything like a {job}.
Text someone your best {adjective} pickup line, and don't explain it.
Describe your {thing} as if you're selling it on a late-night TV ad.
